_meta.description: Heart event #3 for npc_michelle: The Crisis

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Raid aftermath. A badly wounded militia member is brought in]

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: Step back. NOW. This wound needs pressure.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: I need clean water. Bandages. And light. MORE light.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Michelle works with calm, precise efficiency for an hour]

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Her hands are shaking. She hasn't noticed]

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: I... did I? Anyone could have — no. I did. I did that.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: Why am I shaking? It's over. He's fine. Why can't I stop shaking?

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: ...Can you stay? Just for a minute? I just need...

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: Thank you, Jack. For seeing me. Not just the helper. Me.
